Here is the weekly ASX X thread for the week of 5 October 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,247 pts last week and the question this week is simple: can it hold gains with global rate uncertainty creeping back in. Mixed bias — bulls need macro to cooperate. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🏦 Banks face RBA meeting scrutiny on rate guidance. ⛏️ Miners watch China PMI follow-through after last week's data. Two sectors, two catalysts — both binary. #banking #mining #ASX

Post 3

📉 One stock to watch: BHP. Iron ore at USD 98/t keeps margin pressure real. Any China stimulus signal this week flips the trade fast. #ASX #ironore #mining

Post 4

S&P 500 closed near 5,710 pts. US payrolls data lands Friday — a beat above 200k jobs risks pushing yields higher, which historically drags ASX financials and REITs hard. #ASX #ausbiz #inflation

Post 5

RBA decision Tuesday is the week's pin risk. Market prices no change to 3.85%. A hawkish hold spooks property; a dovish tilt lifts banks. Which way are you positioned? #RBA #ASX #ausbiz
